name: Rovering to Sussex
source: Moving to a new town is not easy. Joining a club and making friends may help, but did it have to be scouts? Well, at least this scout group has lots of hot girls! Follow us on a journey of scouting, friendship, love, and sex. These girls don't sell cookies, but play your cards right and they might be up for some nookies. Come and start Rovering to Sussex!
